Collection of dues from Dolphin
Consumers
*421. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the MTNL's
mobile service Dolphin consumers owe
more than Rs. 10 crores to MTNL;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) what steps are being taken to ensure
regular collection of charges from the
consumers?
Interconnect tangle between BSNL
and VSNL
*422. SHRI  ARJUN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the interconnect tangle
between Videsh Sanchar Nigam Limited and
Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited has been
finally closed;
WIN2\SESSION\6471RS-QUES 127
(b) whether all the outstanding issues in
this regard have been settled; and
(c) if so, by when it is likely to function?
Funds to Rajasthan under Central
Road Fund
*423. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount sanctioned to Rajasthan
under the Central Road Fund (CRF),
so far;
(b) the details of the works sanctioned
from the fund during 2000-01, 2001-02 and
2002-03, so far;
(c) whether Government are considering
to fix a time limit for approval of the
proposals and to delegate certain powers of
approval to a Committee on the lines of the
Border Area Development Programme and
PMGY; and
(d) if so, the decision taken in this regard?

Changes in licensing agreement
*424. SHRI  SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have changed the clauses of the licensing
agreement signed with private cellular
players;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) who are the beneficiaries from the
private sector?
Youth Employment Summit
*425. SHRI  YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of LABOUR be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any global conference of the
Youth Employment Summit is proposed to
be held in India in 2003; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Housing scheme for EPF subscribers
*426. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of LABOUR be pleased to refer to
the answer to Unstarred Question 303
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 21st
November, 2002 and state:
(a) what are the terms of reference of the
Committee set up to examine feasibility of
the housing scheme for the Members of the
Employees Provident Fund;
(b) the amount provided as housing loan
during the last two financial years; and
(c) the manner in which the new scheme
is different from the existing scheme?
Cellular telephones
†*427. SHRI  HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of districts in the country
without the cellular telephone services;
(b) whether the benefits of cellular
telephone services are to be extended to these
districts; and
(c) if so, by when?
Non-remittance of Provident Fund
contribution
*428.  SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
  Will the Minister of  LABOUR be
pleased to state:
(a) the number as well as the names of
the employers and companies that have
defaulted in remitting the provident fund
contribution to EPF during the last two years;
(b) the action taken to realise the arrears;
(c) what action has been taken against
those defaulting employers and companies;
(d) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned "Kai
Sal Se P.F. Ki Rakam Jama Nahin Karai"
appearing in the 'Rashtriya Sahara' dated
the 30th June, 2002; and
(e) if so, the action taken in the matter?

Benefits of PMRY
†2979. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
during the two days workshop of India
Habitat Forum conducted in October this
year, unhappiness has been expressed over
the issue that common people are not getting
the benefit of the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar
Yojana;
(b) if so, the details of the implementation
monitoring system of the Pradhan Mantri
Rojgar Yojana alongwith the details of the
people getting benefit of this scheme, State-
wise and Union Territory-wise; and
(c) what new efforts are being made by
Government to ensure that the general public
may get benefits of the scheme in a better
way?
Cottage industries in Nagaland
2980. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for development of cottage
industries in Nagaland and other States of
the North Eastern Region;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the funds allocated for
the purpose during the last three years?
Khadi Gramodyog Commission
†2981. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Khadi and Gramodyog
Commission encourages people for
establishing cottage industries in rural areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

652
WIN2\SESSION\6472RS-QUES 652
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) the number of units of such cottage
industries established after getting incentive
from the said Commission till the end of
October, 2002, State-wise;
(d) the number of people who have been
provided employment in such units,
State-wise; and
(e) the number of sick cottage industries
and the action proposed to be taken by
Government for revival of such units during
the years 2001-02 and 2003-04, State-wise?
Rural Employment Guarantee
Programme
†2982. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of  AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
implementing Rural Employment Guarantee
Programme in the country;
(b) if so, the States where abovesaid
programme was launched during the Ninth
Plan; and
(c) the achievements made during the
said period, the amount spent thereon as
well as the estimates made for the same
during the Tenth Plan, State-wise?
National Programme on Rural
Industrialization
2983. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of the National
Programme on Rural Industrialization in the
industrially backward districts of Rajasthan;
and
(b) the achievements of NPRI in these
districts, district-wise?
Beneficiaries of PMRY in Andhra
Pradesh
2984. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a recent
evaluation study of PMRY in Andhra
Pradesh has revealed that the SC/ST and
women beneficiaries are below the desired
levels;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
and
(c) the remedial measures taken by
Government to increase the number of SC/
ST and women under PMRY in the States?
Loans under PMRY
2985. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons recommended
and those who were actually disbursed loans
under PMRY by the Public Sector Banks in
Andhra Pradesh during the last three years,
year-wise, district-wise and bank-wise;
(b) whether Government have reviewed
the progress of implementation of PMRY
in the State;
(c) if so, what shortcomings were
noticed; and
(d) the steps Government have initiated
to rectify those shortcomings?
Potential of agro industries in Andhra
Pradesh
2986. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed

the potential of agro industries in Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how far this potential is being
utilised; and
(d) what steps Government have taken
to develop marketing facilities in the State
for development of agro industries in a big
way?
India's position in atomic power
generation
